changelog:
New model families and voices:
* Added Silero, Phonon, Vaniq-Edge, Paradis French, STEER, Ito, SupraTTS and AuroraTTS support.
* Added Kokoro 7M English, Nabra Arabic, Noa Hebrew and more sanoTTS voices. The existing Hebrew voice remains available.
* Added officially hosted Hindi and Indonesian Pocket models.

New features:
* Pocket English offers Big, Small and Very small with one shared voice-bank library. Each variant remembers its own bank choice; voices need not be cloned again for each size. Smaller variants can omit or repeat words or change accents with some banks; try another bank or use Big.
* Optional warm-model retention keeps inactive models ready. Preparing upcoming language models and speech can reduce pauses during language switching.
* AI recording restoration uses ONNX without installing PyTorch or a separate Python runtime. Existing restoration installations upgrade on next use; recordings and voice banks are preserved.
* New Pocket voices appear in the voice ring without restarting NVDA. Pocket previews and cloning use the native backend, and short typing/navigation speech starts sooner.
* Expanded number and character handling, mixed-language fallback and downloadable model choices. Check each model's Details for its licence and use restrictions.
* Updated user guides and translations, retaining Dutch and Turkish contributor corrections alongside assisted additions.

Important fixes:
* Restored the full Pocket English starter-voice selection for all three sizes and corrected missing starter banks in fresh Pocket installations. Existing user banks are preserved.
* Fixed silent speech when unset speech settings reach the helper, including first activation. Explicit mute and saved settings are preserved.
* Repaired missing model downloads, model installation/update reporting and matching language frontends.
* Corrected Pocket speaker switching, first-use variant selection and voice/model removal, including long generated-cache paths.
* Improved text boundaries for languages written without spaces and handling of invisible formatting characters, preserving genuine language switching.
* Improved speech cancellation/recovery and Say All position reporting while retaining advance speech generation. Positions inside a combined speech block remain grouped at its end.
* Model downloads use Windows certificate and hostname verification without weakening system security.
